repos_data.description: Image Annotation, including Histopathology slides; From H&E slide to training data in one conversation: nuclei, outlines and slide QC, exported to QuPath, COCO or YOLO. No GPU needed. For Whole Slide Imaging (WSI), Digital and Computational Pathology, Bioinformatics, Tumor Microenvironment (TME) and MLOps Data Labeling.
